DATE:    November 16, 1993

SUBJECT: Accessory Day Care Centers & Day Nurseries


PURPOSE: To permit day care centers and day nursery
          facilities to be established as accessory uses at
          the work place and within multiple dwellings.

REFERENCE: Zoning Resolution Section 12-10 definition of
           accessory uses and Department of Buildings
           Directive 2/76.

EFFECTIVE: Immediately

SUPERCEDES:Technical Policy & Procedure Notice # 12/93 dated
           September 24, 1993.

SPECIFICS: Day care and day nursery facilities are
            customarily found in close proximity to parents
            work places. Those facilities which are not for
            profit may be considered as accessory uses
            within commercial or manufacturing buildings.
            Not for profit day care centers and day
            nurseries can also be considered as accessory
            uses in multiple dwellings when they serve the
            occupants of the building.
      In the event that the primary commercial or
      manufacturing use is terminated, the accessory
      day care center or day nursery facility shall
      likewise be terminated.

      All of these facilities shall comply with the
      Building, Health and Fire Prevention Codes of
      the City of New York and the Department of
      Buildings ("Department") Directive 2/76.
      As part of any application filed with the
      Department of Buildings, affidavits attesting to
      the fact that the use of the facility will be
      limited to occupants or employees of the
      building shall be filed. Such affidavits shall
      be in a form acceptable to the Department.
